name: 三指標と月間推移の組み合わせ
prompt:

One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.

Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.

Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark.
